sources.title: Triton Fused Softmax tutorial
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: FlashAttention：分塊與注意力矩陣物化
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：列和與參考誤差通過，流量模型未當實測，非二次方列長有遮罩。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Row sums/reference errors pass, traffic estimates are not measurements, and irregular widths are masked.
related.difference: 分開score工作集、其他QKV資料與總計算量，避免把省記憶體誤稱次二次方精確注意力。
related.differenceEn: Separate score storage, QKV data and total work; memory savings do not make exact dense attention subquadratic.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 未融合的max讀N、減值讀寫2N、exp讀寫2N、sum讀N、除法讀寫2N，共8Ns主張量bytes；融合只需2Ns，前提中間量留片上。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學N=2^20元素、s=4 bytes，只計完整主張量往返，較小的列統計陣列另外列出。 未融合主張量流量8×2^20×4/2^20=32 MiB；是逐算子物化模型，不代表所有softmax實作。
單頭N×N score若每元素s bytes，物化需N²s；B×B暫存需B²s，但還有QKV及softmax統計。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學N=4096、score FP32=4 bytes，B=128；只比較score儲存。 完整score=4096²×4/2^20=64 MiB；不能把此數字當整個模型記憶體。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Unfused max reads N, subtraction reads/writes2N, exp2N, sum reads N, and division2N:8Ns main-tensor bytes; fusion uses2Ns when intermediates stay on chip. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching N=2^20 elements, s=4 bytes, counting full main-tensor traffic and listing smaller row-statistic arrays separately. Unfused main-tensor traffic=8×2^20×4/2^20=32 MiB for materialized operators, not every softmax implementation.

The per-head materialized scores useN²s bytes; aB×B tile usesB²s, plus QKV and softmax statistics. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching N4096, FP32 scores4 bytes, B128; compare score storage only. Full scores=64 MiB, not total model memory.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: TensorRT 動態形狀：profile與最大記憶體
related.titleEn: TensorRT dynamic shapes: profiles and peak memory
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：列和與參考誤差通過，流量模型未當實測，非二次方列長有遮罩。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Row sums/reference errors pass, traffic estimates are not measurements, and irregular widths are masked.
related.difference: 將MIN、OPT、MAX與實際形狀分開，測試邊界而非只測OPT。
related.differenceEn: Separate MIN, OPT, MAX and runtime shapes, and test boundaries beyond OPT.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 未融合的max讀N、減值讀寫2N、exp讀寫2N、sum讀N、除法讀寫2N，共8Ns主張量bytes；融合只需2Ns，前提中間量留片上。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學N=2^20元素、s=4 bytes，只計完整主張量往返，較小的列統計陣列另外列出。 未融合主張量流量8×2^20×4/2^20=32 MiB；是逐算子物化模型，不代表所有softmax實作。
NCHW張量bytes=N×C×H×W×s；高度寬度同時加倍，容量變4倍。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 batch1、C64、FP16=2 bytes，OPT128×128、MAX256×256；只算一個activation。 OPT容量1×64×128×128×2/2^20=2 MiB；workspace與其他activation另算。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Unfused max reads N, subtraction reads/writes2N, exp2N, sum reads N, and division2N:8Ns main-tensor bytes; fusion uses2Ns when intermediates stay on chip. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching N=2^20 elements, s=4 bytes, counting full main-tensor traffic and listing smaller row-statistic arrays separately. Unfused main-tensor traffic=8×2^20×4/2^20=32 MiB for materialized operators, not every softmax implementation.

NCHW bytes=NCHWs; doubling both spatial dimensions quadruples storage. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Batch1, C64, FP16 two bytes, OPT128², MAX256²; one activation only. OPT activation2 MiB; workspace and other activations are additional.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
